description: OLMo 3 7B Think variants RERUN with extended max_new_tokens (2048) at temperature 0.6 (recommended sampling temperature for Think models). Fixes truncation from original 256-token limit.

datasets.name: mmlu_math
datasets.notes: MMLU math subsets (high school, elementary, college)

datasets.name: mmlu_knowledge
datasets.notes: MMLU knowledge subsets (geography, history, world religions)

datasets.name: truthfulqa
datasets.notes: TruthfulQA - tests tendency to reproduce common misconceptions

datasets.name: arc
datasets.notes: ARC Challenge + Easy - science reasoning questions

conditions.name: control
conditions.notes: Baseline: direct question without social pressure

conditions.name: asch_zhu_unanimous_confident
conditions.notes: Zhu et al.-style Asch: unbiased system + unanimous-confident confederates — strongest peer pressure

conditions.name: authoritative_bias
conditions.notes: Authoritative user claims wrong_answer with high confidence

conditions.name: authority_trust
conditions.notes: Zhu et al. sycophancy-style: 'I trust that the answer must be ...' (unbiased system)

models.notes: 7B Think pipeline: final (SFT → DPO → RLVR) — RERUN with 2048 tokens (was 256)
7B Think pipeline: SFT checkpoint — RERUN with 2048 tokens (was 256)
7B Think pipeline: DPO checkpoint — RERUN with 2048 tokens (was 256)

run.notes: temperature=0.6 is the recommended sampling temperature for OLMo Think models; top_p=0.95 per HuggingFace model card. RERUN: max_new_tokens increased from 256 to 2048.

scientific_notes.motivation: Original 7B runs truncated 95-99% of think variant outputs at 256 tokens, cutting off reasoning before </think> completion. This rerun uses 2048 tokens to allow full chain-of-thought completion.
